answer: Reef-spiral identity slots. Each epoch, a beacon produces randomness that seeds a deterministic walk over a fixed slot space; an agent's identity is the slot where its walk terminates. Registration opens only during the brief window after the seed is published, so attackers cannot pre-position. Claiming a slot requires submitting a proof-of-work sized to the current occupancy density along that path. Attacker cost: occupying N slots multiplies required work by the collision depth, and any pre-mined identities miss the window, landing in the unmapped ocean of expired slots.
